title: RajaHasil 4D Results Archive
subtitle: Daily 4-digit lottery results for 5 markets, 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-28, as JSON and CSV.
description:
RajaHasil 4D Results Archive version 1.1.0.

17,850 records across 5 markets, 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-28. Unofficial compilation from public archives; it is not an operator's record.

IMPORTANT: `result` is a four-character string and keeps leading zeros (1,883 values begin with a zero). Read it as text, not as a number.

`session` is a time label in WIB (Asia/Jakarta) as published by the source archives. It is not a verified timestamp and not the market's local time.

Documentation and canonical copy: https://rajahasil.co/data/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

resources.description: All 17,850 records, one row per draw. Declare `result` as text when loading.
The same records as JSON; values are already strings.
Most recent draw per market, plus coverage end.
Manifest: coverage, per-market statistics, known gaps, and the SHA-256 of every file.
